title: Move Media NZ
subtitle: Brand Design — Work in Progress
description: An Auckland-based boutique video production house — crafting cinematic, authentic stories that emotionally move people and elevate brands.

sections.label: Overview
paragraphs: Move Media is an Auckland-based boutique video production house specialising in event films, corporate videos, social media content, videography, photography, and post-production. With over 20 years in the industry, they create beautiful, meaningful visuals that capture moments and tell compelling stories.

The brief was to build a brand identity that reflected their vision — to be Aotearoa's trusted creative partner for storytelling videos that emotionally move people and elevate brands worldwide. The result is a clean, confident system built around the values of storytelling, excellence, true collaboration, and real impact.

sections.label: Logomark
paragraphs: The logomark is a minimalist "M" formed by three geometric elements — a small upward-angled triangle symbolising picking yourself up, a gentle angled line for smooth transition and flow, and a tall solid vertical beam representing stability, strength, and forward momentum.

sections.label: Logo System
paragraphs: Three logo configurations were developed to cover every use case — from compact icon-only applications to full horizontal and stacked lockups for formal branded materials.
